notes.title: New Track in Demo: DEMOLITION TOWER
notes.content:
[b]DEMOLITION TOWER[/b] is now available in version 0.8.36! This update introduces a new level set in a crumbling city sector slated for demolition.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rAnnwe6.gif[/img]

The game has received major optimizations on Steam Deck and other lower-performance devices. 
New objects, extended [i]Rain City[/i] background, improved [i]Grass Mountains[/i] background with more props:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tv3aHP7.gif[/img]

[b]Patch notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] New level: Demolition Tower.
[*] New level objects: Doors, outdoor AC units, various shattered concrete blocks and metal poles.
[*] [i]Grass Mountains[/i] theme background buildings and animations added.
[*] [i]Hot Lava[/i] theme graphical effects improved.
[*] [i]Rain City[/i] theme background extended.
[*] Performance optimizations. 
[*] Faster level restart.
[/list]

- Baron

notes.title: New Track in Demo: OXIDE RING
notes.content:
[b]OXIDE RING[/b] is now available in version 0.8.33! Introducing a gloomy new level set in the rain-drenched vista of Rain City. On the gameplay front "helmet-first" finishes are now supported thanks to more accurate bike collision shapes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40314603/9ea60caaec2c2d44cd2082b4647296c14da6582b.png[/img]

[b]Patch notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] New level: Oxide Ring.
[*] New level theme: Rain City.
[*] New level objects: water flows, glows.
[*] New polished version of 'Stacks' level with animated grass and background details.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OTosIep.gif[/img]

- Baron

notes.title: New Track in Demo: INFERNAL
notes.content:
[b]INFERNAL[/b] is now available in version 0.8.27! Bringing a scorching new challenge set in a landscape of lava. A new gameplay mechanic makes sure you'll burst into flames if you're not careful:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5TLjDgi.gif[/img]

[b]Patch notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] New level: Infernal.
[*] New level theme: Lava.
[*] Hover platforms. (Can be tested in the Joker card level)
[*] 17 graffiti objects.
[*] Bunch of new neon sign props.
[*] Improved bike destruction details: oil starts leaking & new smoke effects.
[/list]

[i]Version 0.8.26 added fan objects that can boost the bike's speed... or swing the ragdoll faster:[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fpdvnCR.gif[/img]

[i]Version 0.8.24 added some new level background assets:[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Kf7zhHw.png[/img]

[i]Also, the HUD can now be disabled in the settings for a more immersive experience.

- Baron

notes.title: New Track: DREADMILL
notes.content:
[b]DREADMILL[/b] is now available in version 0.8.22! This track throws you into an relentless gauntlet of grinding gears. A fresh leaderboard is live, so there’s a new #1 spot up for grabs!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jURea9I.gif[/img]

[b]Patch notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved background animations: neon signs, flying cars, hover trains, moving construction cranes, factories with billowing smoke, pumpjacks, strange gadgets, etc.
[*] Optimizations, especially Steam Deck: 2× better performance in the most demanding levels, increased resolution, and more effects.
[*] Four different ways the bike can break: front wheel off, back wheel off, both off, bike intact.
[*] Improved PlayStation controller support.
[*] New background theme.
[*] Joker card has a taste of a new level.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0yeRbCN.gif[/img]

[i](Version 0.8.19 previously added the [b]Cloudpiercer[/b] level.)[/i]

- Baron

notes.title: Ultrawide support!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/deETxVX.gif[/img]

Ultrawide support for aspect ratios up to 32:9 now in the game, as requested on the Steam forums.

Also, an upcoming track is in the works, created to the old-timer level building tune The Ground Is At A Great Distance*.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/u73Z1Op.gif[/img]

Want to show support for the game? A great way to do that is to leave a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3261400/Bike_Baron_2_The_Art_of_Riding_Demo/]review[/url] for the demo. It helps the algorithm on Steam pick the game up.

Enjoy your holidays and I'll see you all on the leaderboard!

* The original tune has been lost in time, sadly.

-Kimmo-
